description: Lifecycle hooks for Claude Code enforcing Mitosis Orchestrator multi-tier delegation policy.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" session-start || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" session-start || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" session-start || exit 0

python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-invocation || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-invocation || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-invocation || exit 0

python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-tool-use || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-tool-use || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-tool-use || exit 0

python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" post-tool-use || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" post-tool-use || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" post-tool-use || exit 0

python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" subagent-stop || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" subagent-stop || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" subagent-stop || exit 0

python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" stop || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" stop || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" stop || exit 0
